events.title: Conversation Corner with Simon Rowe
events.description: SATURDAY, October 10th, CONVERSATION CORNER AT KEYS CAFÉ: "Building an Analog Community in a Digital World" Marking the four-year Birthday Celebration, Keys Owner, Simon Rowe discusses the growth and evolution of the Keys Community in the face of so many "virtual" alternatives. Come join us for a relaxed conversation and a delicious brunch at Keys[...]
